title: Adaptive Welcome Carousel: Configurable Quickstart Templates for Console
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: New users land on the Console and face a dense surface of dashboards, models, and routing settings. Current empty states and tip overlays are one-size-fits-all and do not adapt to persona or team needs, leading to longer time-to-value and higher drop-off during the first 24 hours.

Goal: Design an adaptive welcome carousel that surface-configurable quickstart templates (e.g., 'Prototype Chat', 'Embeddings Search', 'Batch Inference') and persona-tailored tips. Provide an admin toggle to preselect templates for orgs and a lightweight path for first-time users to pick their goal. The experience should be low-friction, measurable, and compatible with existing console release/rollout flags.
summary_of_work: Created three card templates, a minimal onboarding microflow, and admin configurator UI. Prototyped animation states, keyboard accessibility, and skip/restore behavior. Documented tracking events for funnel analysis and designed A/B test variants for 'guided' vs 'self-serve' flows.
decisions: Use horizontal carousel with progressive disclosure instead of multi-step modal to reduce cognitive load
Persist user selection in profile; allow admins to pin a default org-level quickstart
Keep CTA primary action minimal: 'Start Template' and secondary 'Explore Console'
Defer advanced configuration (RBAC-linked templates) to a follow-up ticket
acceptance_criteria: Carousel appears for new users on first Console visit unless org admin has pinned a template
Selecting a template instantly provisions a sandbox project with starter snippets (prototype config created by backend), verified by network mock in prototype
Analytics events fire for view, select, complete steps: console.welcome.view, console.welcome.select, console.welcome.complete
Keyboard and screen-reader accessibility verified in design review notes
Admin configurator reachable from Console > Settings > Onboarding and respects rollout flags
tasks: Finalize visual token specs and handoff tokens to frontend
Add spec sheet for persisted state (where to store selection) for backend
Implement lightweight opt-out and 'Show me again' control
Prepare A/B experiment plan and goal metrics (time-to-first-invoke, sandbox creation rate)

notes_for_engineering: Frontend should support server-side rollout flags and a feature toggle 'welcome_carousel_v2'. Provide hooks for persisting selection in user profile and exposing a 'restore default' endpoint. Include telemetry contract: console.welcome.view/select/complete with template_id and org_pinned boolean.
experiment_plan: Variant A (guided carousel) vs Variant B (compact quickstart tiles). Primary metric: time-to-first-invoke (target 20% reduction). Secondary metrics: sandbox creation rate, 7-day retention. Sample size: 10k new users over 3 weeks.
ux_research: Recruit 8 users across developer and product manager personas for moderated testing
Focus on comprehension of 'template' language and friction in selecting starter flows
implementation_notes: Avoid blocking product launch for initial orgs: ship in 'guided' mode behind rollout flag, admin configurator behind separate flag. Coordinate release window with Growth team to run experiment.
